title: Triceps Pushdown
summary: Cable pushdown with the arms at your sides: triceps 1. The lateral and medial heads do most of it (short heads 1, long head 0.6).

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: All three heads straighten the elbow. With the arm by your side the long head (which crosses the shoulder) is shorter, so it rates 0.6 vs 1.

region_notes.text: Overhead extensions grew the long head about 1.5 times more than pushdown-position extensions.

setup.text: High pulley with a rope or bar.
Stand close, elbows at your sides.

form_cues.why: Elbows fixed at the sides keeps the work on the triceps.
Full lockout is the triceps' shortest point.
Bringing the hands back up to the chest is the stretch.

form_cues.cue: Spread the rope at the bottom

bias_tweaks.effect: Personal preference; the rope allows a fuller lockout.
Same work per arm; useful for an uneven side.

bias_tweaks.change: Lower in 2-3 seconds and pause briefly in the stretch
bias_tweaks.effect: Keeps tension on in the lengthened position and removes bounce, so each rep starts honestly.
bias_tweaks.caveat: Rep speeds from 0.5 to 8 s gave similar growth; this is a control tool, not a growth trick.

mistakes.text: Leaning over the stack and pushing with body weight.
mistakes.fix: Lighten until the elbows stay pinned.

mistakes.text: Leaning over the bar and pushing with bodyweight.

misconceptions.myth: Pushdowns work all of the triceps equally.
misconceptions.reality: Overhead work grew the long head more.

misconceptions.myth: Machines don't build muscle like free weights.
misconceptions.reality: Free-weight and machine training gave similar muscle growth in a meta-analysis. Pick by fit, stability and how well you can push close to failure.

lower_risk.text: The app adds no ramp-up sets here. If the muscle is not warm from earlier work, make the first set a little lighter.

Add load in small steps. The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first, up to 2 past the top of the range. Default steps for this equipment are 2.5 kg or 5 lb; your gym profile can replace them.
Aim for about 2 reps in reserve in the 10-15 rep range. Low-risk to push close to failure.
Pick a variation, range and setup you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Overhead: grew the long head more.
Lying extension with a longer stretch.
Dumbbell kickback; hardest at the top.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only

notes: The overhead vs pushdown finding is one 12-week MRI study in 21 adults.
Ratings and display bands are the library model (main >= 0.75, helper 0.4 to < 0.75, minor 0.25 to < 0.4, not counted < 0.25).
Technique and load management only. This page makes no medical or injury claims.
